notes.notes:
Highlights of this update include:

Feed FM music streaming
New menu structure
Look up for new in-game HUD
Removal of resistance-based gameplay and scoring

Additional details available at VirZOOM News.

notes.title: VirZOOM Update: July 18, 2017
notes.notes:
Highlights of this update include:

Bike firmware update allows for multiple bikes in one place more easily
River Run fuel more frequent early, tapers later
VZ Sensor support in advance of release
Le Tour ("up in the air") and Gem Hunt (restart crash) bugs fixed

Additional details available at VirZOOM News.

notes.title: VirZOOM Update: May 2, 2017
notes.notes:
Highlights of this update include:

Reorganized menus – get into Quickplay faster, check Options for avatar upgrades & user switching 
360° video – press d-pad left, then d-pad down to toggle video capture on PC 
Fixes & tweaks – River Run tuning, ghost fixes

Visit VirZOOM News for more details.

Visit VirZOOM News for more details.
